ctaText: Contact McKee Security today. We will assess your needs, recommend the right Yealink hardware, and provide a clear quote with no surprises. Call us at (705) 457-2156 or use the inquiry form below.
html:
Professional VoIP Phone Service

COMMERCIAL & RESIDENTIAL VOIP

Hosted phone service for businesses and homes across the Haliburton Highlands. Most of what we install goes into offices, shops and clinics, and the rest replaces landlines in homes on the same platform. Either way we supply the hardware, configure the system, port your number, and stay the people you call when something needs attention.

Business or Home, Same Local Team

Both run on the same hosted platform, and both are installed, tested and supported by our own technicians rather than a call centre in another province.

For Your Business

Desk phones, auto-attendant, call routing and voicemail to email, plus cordless handsets for the parts of the building that are nowhere near a desk.

See business phone systems

For Your Home

A straight landline replacement over the internet connection you already have, with unlimited calling and your existing number if you want to keep it.

See home phone service
For Your Business

Commercial Phone Systems

From a single phone at a front counter to a multi-extension office with cordless handsets out in the shop. Hosted on our managed platform, provisioned by our team, and ported over from your current provider without downtime.

Everything a Busy Office Runs On

Multiple numbers, call routing, auto-attendant, voicemail to email, hold music and call transfer, all configured around how your office actually answers the phone. We port your existing numbers from your current provider and only cut over once the new system has been tested end to end, so nothing goes dark.

Because the system is not built around physical lines, the ceiling on simultaneous calls disappears. Every phone can be on a call at once, your main number rings the whole building, messages collect in one voicemail box instead of one per line, and outbound calls all show your main number.

Auto-Attendant Voicemail to Email No Limit on Simultaneous Calls Multiple Numbers & DID Call Transfer & Hold Zero-Downtime Porting

Cordless Coverage for the Whole Site

Plenty of work does not happen at a desk. Yealink DECT handsets register to the same system as your desk phones, so a call to your main number rings the front counter and the far end of the warehouse at once and whoever gets there first picks up. Add them to a system that already has desk phones, and choose rugged models where a service bay or an outdoor yard is hard on equipment.

Rings With Your Desk Phones Shop, Bay & Yard Coverage Rugged Handset Options One Number, One Voicemail Expands As You Grow

Yealink Professional Desk Phones

Four tiers, from a busy front counter to a multi-extension office. Every tier carries the same HD voice and background noise suppression, so the choice comes down to screen size, key count and how the handset works, never to call quality. All models support PoE and are provisioned and tested by our team before they arrive.

Yealink T73 Entry Level Phone

A straightforward business phone with nothing extra to learn. Colour display, a comfortable handset, and a row of keys you can set as one-touch dials for the people you call most.

Yealink T74 Mid Tier Phone

The same phone with a noticeably larger and sharper display and more room for one-touch dials. Easy to read a caller's name at a glance from across the desk.

Yealink T85W Premium Phone

The one we recommend, and the phone most of our business systems are built on. A large 5.5-inch display on a stand that tilts to your eye level, backlit keys that stay easy to find in a dim room, and Bluetooth built in for a wireless headset.

Yealink T88W Pro Executive Phone

The only phone in the range with a genuinely cordless handset, with roughly thirty feet of range, so you can answer at the desk and keep talking as you walk. Large Android touchscreen you tap rather than work through buttons.

For Your Home

The Same System, at Home

Fewer homes keep a landline every year, and the ones that do usually keep it because switching sounded like a project. It is not. Residential VoIP runs on the same hosted platform as our business systems, is installed by the same technicians, and keeps your existing number if you want it.

Reliable Home Phone Service, Without the Landline

Everything you expect from a home phone: HD voice, voicemail, caller ID, call waiting, and unlimited local and long distance calling across Canada and North America, all delivered over the internet connection you already have. We install and configure the equipment, transfer your existing number if you would like to keep it, and remain your direct point of contact for ongoing support.

Unlimited NA Calling Voicemail & Caller ID Call Forwarding E911 Compliance Managed Number Porting Local McKee Support

Residential Yealink DECT Cordless Systems

Every home install is a Yealink DECT cordless system: purpose-built VoIP handsets with HD audio, long range, and a clean modern design that suits a house rather than an office. Multiple handsets register to a single W70B base station, so any phone in the house can answer the same line.

Yealink W70B Base Yealink DECT Handsets HD Audio Long Range DECT Multi-Handset Support

Why McKee Security VoIP

Locally managed. Professionally installed. Personally supported.

We Configure Every Account

When you sign up for VoIP through McKee Security, you are not signing up for a self-serve platform. We configure every account, install every phone, and stay your direct point of contact for the life of your service.

Tested Before It Rings

Our technicians provision hardware, test call quality, verify E911 registration, and walk you through the system before the job is complete. Our hosted platform is managed on the back end by our carrier partner.

30+ Years in Haliburton

We have been supporting residential and commercial clients across the Haliburton region for over 30 years. VoIP is a natural extension of that relationship. It is one more way we keep your home or business connected.

Pricing on Inquiry

Every installation is different, so we quote rather than list. Contact us for a no-obligation quote on either side of the service.

Commercial VoIP

Quoted on the number of extensions, the Yealink tier you choose, how many cordless handsets you need, and whether existing numbers are being ported across.

Residential VoIP

Quoted on how many handsets you want around the house and whether you are keeping your existing number. Installed and supported by our local team.
